== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34567) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Law DS Shadow Collective.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 28 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 28 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>573eff8cb4bf4fb090e005ecc2811dbdd492d5a5eb94328fd924069099d1b0fe</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_71^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
